pages.title: Read the Tooltip
pages.text: Check a pill tooltip for its purpose, duration, and activation conditions. Pills stack to 16.$(br2)Qi Return restores Qi; Qingling also adds cultivation progress; Spring Return restores health; Spirit Nourishing restores Thoughts; Spirit Gathering aids cultivation. Consult the actual item for its current values.

pages.title: Defenses and Status
pages.text: Crimson Flame aids fire attacks and cold resistance; Ice Heart extinguishes burning and resists fire; Essence Stabilizing aids defense and knockback resistance; Iron Bones strengthens defense but slows movement; Evil Warding removes and prevents Wither.$(br2)These effects expire. Observe your actual status rather than treating them as permanent attributes.

pages.title: Conditional Pills
pages.text: Barrier Breaking strengthens the next successful melee hit; Qi Condensing discounts the next Qi-consuming spell; Meridian Renewal triggers recovery when health falls dangerously low.$(br2)Swallowing a pill does not immediately trigger every effect. Meet its conditions before expiry and check the remaining effect.
